title: Look up the person's configured email address
description: The email address and display name of the account the person set up in the DSphere Agent Email panel, and whether mail can be sent from it (canSend: an SMTP login is set up) and reached now (available: the Native Agent is connected and supports mail).
guidance: Use it to address mail to the person, for example a question or a confirmation sent with dsagent.mail.send whose reply you then find with dsagent.mail.search. When configured is false there is no account and email is null; only the person sets one up, in Email → Settings. It never returns servers, user names or passwords.

configured.description: Whether the person has set up an account in the Email panel.

available.description: Whether the Native Agent mail transport is reachable now.

canSend.description: Whether the account has an SMTP login, so dsagent.mail.send can send from it.

email.description: The account's email address, or null when none is set up.

displayName.description: The name mail is sent under, or null when none is set up.
